generation_rule: Compose 66 original five-minute instrumental tracks from text only. Existing 36 completed tracks stay unchanged. Tracks 37-66 are upbeat Lofi Hip Hop and groovy boom bap with punchy drums, active bass, strong head-nod rhythms, sparse short guitar/synth/keys motifs and no saxophone or jazz lounge. Never recreate third-party recordings, samples, melody or arrangement; each track has a distinct intro and identity.
diversity_policy: Reject overly similar first 45 seconds versus every approved Lofi Hip Hop track 01-66; regenerate with new original intro and groove.
